simple.meaning: to be straight or even ; figuratively, to be (causatively, to make ) right , pleasant , prosperous
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָשַׁר (H3474) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

definitions.short: to be straight or even ; figuratively, to be (causatively, to make ) right , pleasant , prosperous
definitions.usage: direct, fit, seem good (meet), please (will), be (esteem, go) right (on), bring (look, make, take the) straight (way), be upright(-ly).
definitions.full: H3474. yashar יָשַׁר verb be smooth, straight, right (Late Hebrew id. , and derivatives; Arabic be Gentle, tractable easy, II. make easy; manageable, easy , but Sabean יתֿרן אהל הותֿר, ותֿר, Os ZMG 1865, 270 CIS iv, 29, 2 ; Assyrian Išâu , be or go straight, right , mêšêru , justice , mêšêriš , righteously , Dl HWB 310 ) — Qal Perfect יָשַׁר Jer 18:4 2 t.; 3 feminine יָשְׁרָה Judg 14:3 ; Hab 2:4 ; 3 masculine plural יָָֽשְׁרוּ 1Kin 9:12 ; Imperfect יִישַׁר Num 23:27 2 t.; יִשַׁר 1Sam 18:20 , 26 ; 3 feminine singular תִּישַׁר Judg 14:7 ; 3 feminine plural יִשַּׁרְנָה 1Sam 6:12 (Ges § 47 , n. 3; 71) — 1 go straight , בַּדֶּרֶךְ in the way 1Sam 6:12 . 2 figurative, be pleasing, agreeable, right ( בְּעֵינֵי in the yees of ); said of a woman Judg 14:3 , 7 ; a man Jer 27:5 ; of matters and things ( הַדָּבָר ) 1Sam 18:20 , 26 ; 2Sam 17:4 ; 1Chr 13:4 ; 2Chr 30:4 ; of cities 1Kin 9:12 ; a place הָאֱלֹהִים בְּעֵינֵי Num 23:27 (E); with כַּאֲשֶׁר Jer 18:4 . 3 in ethical sense , straightforward, upright ; בּוֺ נַפְשׁוֺ לֹאיָָֽשְׁרָה Hab 2:4 his soul is not upright in him (opposed to עֻמְּלָה swollen ). Pi`el Perfect 1 ׳יִשָּׁ֑רְתִּ Psa 119:128 ( יִשְׁרֵהוּ Job 37:3 , 3 masculine suffix Thes; but < Ew Di Hi De Da, Imperfect from שָׁרָה ); Imperfect יְיַשֵּׁר Prov 3:6 ; יְיַשֶּׁרֿ 15:21 ; suffix וַיְיַשְּׁרֵם (Masoretes abbreviated וַיַּשְּׁרֵם ) 2Chr 32:30 ; 3 feminine singular תְּיַשֵּׁר Prov 11:4 ; 1 singular אֲיַשֵּׁר Isa 45:13 ; אֲיַשֵּׁר 45:2 Qr (Kt Hiph`il אוֺשִׁר Ges § 70 , 2 doubtless copyist's error); Imperative plural יַשְּׁרוּ 40:3 ; Participle plural מְיַשְּׁרִים Prov 9:15 ; — 1 make smooth, straight , accusative מְסִלָּה Isa 40:3 ; הֲדוּרִים 45:2 ; figurative, with דֶּרֶךְ make smooth or straight , i.e. free from obstacles, successful 45:13 ; Prov 11:5 , אֹרַח 3:5 ; in ethical sense, אָרְחוֺתָם הַמְיַשְּׁרִים 9:15 those making straight their paths , going straightforward on their paths; יְיַשֶּׁרלָֿ֑כֶת 15:21 maketh straight his going, goeth straightforwards. 2 lead straight along direct , waters of an aqueduct 2Chr 32:30 ; (of the thunder Job 37:3 according to some; but see rather שָׁרָה ) 3 esteem right, approve Psa 119:128 (read יִשָּׁ֑רְתִּי לי פקודיך כל ). Pu`al Participle מְיֻשָּׁר זָהָב 1Kin 6:35 gold made level, laid smoothly out, upon the graven work. Hiph`il Imperfect 3plural נֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ יַיְשִׁרוּ עַפְעַמֶּיךָ Prov 4:25 let thine eyelids look straight before thee; Imperative דַּרְכֶּךָ הַיְ֯שַׁר make thy way even Psa 5:9 Qr (Kt הוֺשַׁר ; see Ges 70 (2)).
